'''Moris Malvarra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Malvarra was assigned by the Alliance to be the [[Alliance observer|observer]] of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group [[Dharus' Buccaneers]]. However, before the tour of duty was one-third complete, Malvarra requested to be transferred to a different assignment. [[Ral'Rai Muvunc]] of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] replied to the request, refusing Malvarra a transfer.
